activities.activity_description: Implement functions to retrieve existing application, orderer, or consortium org configuration returning a config.Organization without manual parsing (U1).
Implement functions to update an application org's and application group's configuration by adding or removing policies (U2).
Implement functions to update an orderer org's and orderer group's configuration by adding or removing policies (U3).
Implement functions to update a consortium org's, consortiums group's, and consortium group's configuration by adding or removing policies (U4).
Implement a fit-for-purpose function that adds an orderer org definition to a channel configuration, returning a channel transaction (U5).
Implement a fit-for-purpose function that adds an application org definition to a channel configuration, returning a channel transaction (U6).
Implement a function to retrieve existing MSP configuration for an organization without manually parsing the config transaction (U7).
Implement a function to verify a cert was issued by an MSP and revoke it by modifying the revocation_list attribute of FabricMSPConfig (U8).
Update example tests to demonstrate usage of all new helper functions and features, and update relevant API documentation (U1-U8).
